title: server: create KirkContract types
description: Create type definitions for KirkContract structures used in the Progressive Discover system. These types define the contract specification format for server-side validation and enforcement.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide KirkContract type definitions for all contract operations
THE SYSTEM SHALL ensure type safety for all contract-related data structures

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a new contract type is defined
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL validate the type structure against the KirkContract schema
THE SYSTEM SHALL produce deterministic JSON output

unwanted.condition: IF a contract type definition is incomplete
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT register the type
unwanted.because: incomplete types cause runtime validation failures

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT accept the type definition

preconditions: Base KirkContract schema must be loaded
Type registry must be available for registration
postconditions: All KirkContract types are registered in the type system
Types are serializable to JSON format
Types implement required traits for validation
invariants: Type definitions shall be immutable after registration
Type names shall be unique within the registry
Type schemas shall be versioned for compatibility

happy: Given valid KirkContract type parameters, when a type is created, then the type is registered and accessible
Given a registered KirkContract type, when serialization is requested, then valid JSON is produced
Given multiple related types, when they are defined, then type relationships are properly established
error: Given a type with duplicate name, when registration is attempted, then DUPLICATE_TYPE error is returned
Given a type with invalid schema reference, when creation is attempted, then INVALID_SCHEMA error is returned
Given a type with circular dependencies, when validation runs, then CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY error is returned
